interpretation.label: denominator_lost_at_approach_initiation
interpretation.note: Approaches are essentially never initiated: the agent does not head for benefit-bearing targets at all, so the missing consumption events are lost UPSTREAM of arrival. This confirms at battery level the substrate-level reading of the 2026-08-18 navigation-immobility scoping spike (MECH-439 F-dominance conversion ceiling, amplified by the E3 hold-and-repeat cadence). Read pooled_move_efficacy and e3_tick_fraction_mean alongside: they say how much of the immobility is wall-blocking and how much is cadence rather than selection.

preconditions.name: ARM_PRECOMMIT::movement_instrument_live
preconditions.description: Forced cardinal movement actions from a fresh env DO change the agent's cell, so a count of position changes measures motion rather than instrument failure.
preconditions.control: Positive control: a throwaway env stepped through each of the 4 cardinal actions, counting cell changes. This is the SAME statistic the load-bearing criterion routes on (a COUNT OF POSITION CHANGES), not a magnitude or distance proxy for it -- the V3-EXQ-643 same-statistic rule. Measured 2026-08-19 on this env: 4 of 4.

preconditions.name: ARM_PRECOMMIT::window_instrument_live
preconditions.description: The cell stepped the decomposition window at all. Below this floor no rate normalised by realised ticks is measurable.
preconditions.control: n_realised_ticks counted directly in the eval loop.

preconditions.name: ARM_PRECOMMIT::benefit_bearing_resources_present
preconditions.description: Benefit-bearing (goal-tag) resource cells were live on the grid. 874b defect (2) made into a gate: an APPROACH is undefined without a target, and 874b let this count vary silently with its ruleset axis.
preconditions.control: Mean live goal-tag cells read off the env's own _resource_type_grid each tick -- measured, not inferred from nominal spawn weights.

preconditions.name: ARM_PRECOMMIT::approach_is_definable
preconditions.description: The agent was not already sitting on / adjacent to its nearest target for the whole window, so there was somewhere to approach FROM.
preconditions.control: Mean Chebyshev distance to the nearest benefit-bearing cell over the window. Step 2.5b adversarial design audit (2026-08-19): with 12 resources on a 6x6 grid the mean distance is small, and at distance 0 no STRICT decrease is possible -- so a near-zero mean distance would produce an approach_initiation_rate of ~0 that ALIASES onto the `never_approached` verdict while meaning the opposite (the agent was already there). Same statistic the initiation count is derived from.

preconditions.name: ARM_PRECOMMIT::distance_instrument_live
preconditions.description: A distance-to-nearest-target was computable on the window's ticks, so an approach/retreat classification is defined.
preconditions.control: n_distance_samples counted whenever a goal-tag cell existed.

evidence_direction_note: Governance 2026-08-21 gov-20260821-0203 ratified failure_autopsy_940-941-mech467-cluster_2026-08-20.json: V3-EXQ-941 (GOV-FANOUT-1 H-denominator leg, measurement axis) is a denominator diagnostic with zero wrong-target instrumentation and does not exercise MECH-467's falsifier; it bears on the claim in neither direction. Its FAIL is the INFORMATIVE result by design (the queue note says so explicitly: outcome PASS would have been the null). It localises the missing denominator upstream of arrival: 6 approach initiations, 2 arrivals and 4 consumption events over 3681 realised ticks, with approach_run_length_max = 1 in both arms -- no approach run ever exceeded a single step. Two caveats bound how far the finding travels. (1) The basis is thin: seed 43 sat fully immobile for 900/900 ticks in BOTH arms, contributing 48.9% of the denominator and zero signal, and its aliasing was meant to be caught by the approach_is_definable precondition whose 0.0 floor cannot fire (mean_distance_to_goal was exactly 1.0, one step from a target on a grid where one step is arrival). (2) C2 (0.333333) and C3 (4) are stamped passed but rest on <=6 events; C3 as coded is a pooled existence test (total_events > 0) across both arms despite owned_by_arms ARM_PRECOMMIT, and consumption exceeds arrivals 2:1 with 2 of the 4 events in cells recording zero initiations and zero arrivals -- so it certifies only that >=1 consumption happened somewhere, and the denominator_lost_at_consumption branch is unreachable in practice on this env. Neither affected the verdict (the routing tests C1 first). The run also newly quantifies the immobility at battery level: pooled_move_efficacy 0.0115/0.0124 and e3_tick_fraction_mean ~0.104. Its claim to 'confirm' the MECH-439 F-dominance ceiling should be read as 'is consistent with and quantifies', not as independent confirmation: at 98.8% blocked moves and 89-91% latched ticks both are near-ceiling simultaneously and cannot decompose the immobility, and no selection-layer measurement was taken.
